sig: [[["A", "Welcome back to Work Smarter, the podcast for people who'd rather be doing their jobs than sitting in meetings. I'm Josh."], ["A", "Today's topic: running remote meetings that people actually want to attend."], ["A", "Tip number one: send the agenda at least twenty-four hours ahead."], ["A", "If people don't know why they're there, they won't come prepared."], ["A", "Tip two: keep it small. Research suggests decisions get harder once you go past about seven people."], ["A", "If someone only needs the outcome, send them the notes instead."], ["A", "Tip three: cameras. Now, I'm not going to tell you to force everyone to turn them on."], ["A", "But for discussions that need real decisions, do ask people to, because you'll pick up on reactions you'd otherwise miss."], ["A", "And tip four, my favourite: end five minutes early."], ["A", "Back-to-back calls are exhausting, and those five minutes give people a chance to grab a coffee or stretch."], ["A", "After the break, I'll be talking to Sarah Kim, a manager who cut her team's meeting time in half in just three months."], ["A", "Stick around."]], {"A": "M-AU"}]
